title: Return Policy — Furniture
text: Furniture items may be returned within 14 days of delivery, subject to a 15% restocking fee to cover inspection and repackaging. The item must be disassembled and returned in its original packaging where possible; a repackaging fee applies otherwise. Custom or made-to-order items (e.g. custom sofas) are final sale and not eligible for return except in cases of manufacturing defect. Assembled furniture returns require a scheduled pickup rather than customer drop-off shipping.
